title: Preserve Lightroom crop corner pairing through EXIF orientation
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; renewed integration of PR187)
notes: Preserve the original opposing corners through EXIF orientation before fine rotation. New/re-imported rotated or reflected Lightroom crops intentionally receive corrected bounds. Zero-angle rounding, the image rotation sign and existing stored edits are unchanged. Geometry bounds and Lightroom dimension agreement do not establish pixel registration or colour parity.
